thought_process: The query needs to list books whose publisher is 'Yale University Press'. This requires joining the books table with the publishers table on publisher_id. A simple equality filter on the publisher name is sufficient. No other tables are needed.
sql: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.year, b.published FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher = 'Yale University Press';
explanation: Shows all books that were published by Yale University Press, including their ID, title, long‑list year, and publication date.
